_comment: Jar-count ramp, difficulty rhythm, twists and generator budgets. Levels 1-30 come from levels_authored.json.

wrapped.title: Wrapped candies
wrapped.text: Some candies hide in paper wrappers. A wrapper opens when its candy reaches the top.

cloth.title: Dhaka-cloth jar
cloth.text: This jar is covered with a woven cloth. Fill any 2 jars and the cloth slides off.

lock.title: Padlocked jar
lock.text: A brass padlock! Fill a jar of the candy on its badge to unlock it.

tall.title: Tall jar
tall.text: A tall jar holds 2 extra candies. Handy storage space!
